brief: Inspect Camden Green prior to the forecast heat event to verify the unverified cooling system resulting from overdue detailed maintenance [REG-042]. Because this unit of advanced age has a history of high loading and reduced margin against mechanical failure, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if it cannot be attended before the event [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
